name: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 Ti
notes: Launch article states 3584 CUDA cores and 11 GB GDDR5X at 11 Gbps, and nothing else numeric. Bus width, bandwidth and board power are therefore null here rather than copied from a spec-aggregator. 11 GB holds a 7B Q4 with tight KV headroom and does not hold a 13B Q4. No tensor cores. || Filled 2026-10-19: Founder's Edition: 11 GB GDDR5X on 352-bit at 11 Gbps = 484 GB/s. NVIDIA's current site redirects this legacy page; values are the vendor's published spec (AIB cards at 11.4 Gbps reach ~501 GB/s).
